summary: 113 tests passed, 99.0% coverage, all quality gates passed

completion_promises.evidence: Created scripts/verify-nats.sh with #!/bin/sh shebang and chmod +x. Tests test_script_file_exists, test_script_is_executable, test_script_has_shebang, and test_script_is_not_empty all pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script checks NATS server is healthy via port 8222 healthcheck
completion_promises.evidence: Script checks http://localhost:8222/healthz via curl -sS with --max-time timeout. Default NATS_MONITOR_URL is http://localhost:8222. Verifies HTTP 200 response code. Tests test_checks_healthz_endpoint and test_uses_curl_for_healthcheck pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script verifies JetStream is enabled via /jsz endpoint
completion_promises.evidence: Script curls /jsz endpoint and validates JetStream info by checking for memory/storage/config fields in the JSON response using jq (or grep fallback). Tests test_checks_jsz_endpoint, test_uses_curl_for_jetstream, and test_validates_jetstream_info all pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script verifies server_name is 'ships-computer' via /varz endpoint
completion_promises.evidence: Script curls /varz endpoint, extracts server_name field via jq or grep fallback, and compares against 'ships-computer'. Also extracts and reports the server version. Tests test_checks_varz_endpoint, test_uses_curl_for_server_info, test_checks_server_name_ships_computer, and test_checks_server_name_field all pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script reports clear PASS/FAIL for each check
completion_promises.evidence: Script uses pass_check() and fail_check() helper functions that output [PASS] and [FAIL] prefixed messages via echo. Each of the 4+ checks uses these functions. Tests test_reports_pass, test_reports_fail, test_pass_and_fail_used_in_output, and test_reports_multiple_checks (verifying at least 3 PASS and 3 FAIL output paths) all pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script exits with non-zero code if any check fails
completion_promises.evidence: Script tracks exit_code variable (initialized to 0, set to 1 by fail_check). Final line is 'exit $exit_code'. Also has early 'exit 1' for startup timeout. Tests test_has_exit_with_non_zero, test_tracks_failure_state, and test_has_exit_zero_on_success all pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script works both locally and in CI (uses curl, not nats CLI dependency)
completion_promises.evidence: All core checks (health, JetStream, server info) use curl. The nats CLI is only used for optional account auth checks, gated behind 'command -v nats' with clear [SKIP] message when unavailable. Tests test_uses_curl_command, test_does_not_require_nats_cli (verifies >= 3 curl uses), and test_optional_nats_cli_for_auth all pass.
